name: saddle
description: Orchestrate saddle's parallel Claude Code agents from your own Claude Code session: plan from issues, spawn workers in worktrees, answer their prompts, land them through the merge train and open stacked PRs. Needs the saddle binary on PATH.

claimGuard.title: Claim guard in worker sessions
claimGuard.description: In saddle's worker sessions, hold Edit, Write and NotebookEdit calls (and obvious Bash writes) on paths the task has not claimed, and ask the worker to claim first. The orchestrator's session is never guarded.
